//react-router-dom: PINNED ABOVE 7.11.0 ON PURPOSE. npm audit reports GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 (high) against react-router and offers `npm audit fix --force`, which DOWNGRADES react-router-dom 7 minor versions to 7.11.0. Do not run it. The advisory is a CSRF bypass in RSC Mode; this app is a pure client-side SPA (BrowserRouter in src/main.jsx, plus Navigate/Link/useNavigate only) and has no RSC, no server actions, and no data-router actions — the vulnerable path does not exist here. REVOKE THIS the moment the app adopts RSC or server actions: then the advisory becomes reachable and the pin must be re-evaluated. See docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-07-27 and 2026-08-06. (This note is a top-level key because JSON has no comments and npm fails with EINVALIDPACKAGENAME on a '//' key inside dependencies.)
